# Swap XRP — Exchange XRP Cross-Chain Reference

> Exchange XRP — the native asset of the XRP Ledger — for stablecoins and tokens on other chains, through exchanges or non-custodial cross-chain swap services.

## Key Facts
- XRP: native asset of the XRP Ledger (XRPL), a standalone, non-EVM blockchain
- Not an ERC-20 token — Ethereum wallets and same-chain DEXs do not hold XRP directly
- Swap paths: centralized exchange, or non-custodial cross-chain swap service
- XRP↔EVM requires a cross-chain route, not a same-chain DEX trade
- Costs: XRPL transaction fee (XRP) + exchange/service fee & spread + destination network fee
- Many exchange deposits require a destination tag to credit XRP correctly
